verdict.rationale: The ranking-and-relevance docs include a section titled "Text Match Score & Type", which suggests Typesense exposes a per-result text-match score that could show why a result ranked where it did. Beyond that heading, the pack has no detail on what the score contains or how to read it. Missing for 10: documented per-hit score breakdown or explain output, how scores combine across ranking criteria (text match, sort fields, vector or hybrid), and independent or hands-on confirmation that scores are useful for debugging rankings.
